changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate dataset references and normalized model names to canonical forms. Removed 'Paragraph Generation' as redundant with 'Text Generation'. Kept only canonical model names with full version identifiers.
'honorific correctness' is an evaluation criterion, not an automatic metric. Cohen's kappa was normalized to standard form.
GPT-4o was used explicitly as a judge to evaluate honorific correctness in generated outputs, not just for generation.

guideline: If you were writing an article (Wikipedia-style or blog post) about the same entity for a general online audience, what kind of pronouns/verbs would you use? (Honorific/Non-Honorific)
